title: Set and Follow If-Then Rules for Productivity
description: Define your own if-then rules to make decisions easier and create consistent actions. Use the app to: - Select a template for your rule. - Write down conditions and actions, such as: - If a meeting takes longer than 30 minutes, then I’ll summarize key points immediately after. - If I finish one task early, then I’ll spend the extra time reviewing the next one. - If I feel overwhelmed, then I’ll take a short walk to reset. - Start following your rule and track how it helps you stay focused and effective. These rules work as simple frameworks to reduce stress and boost your productivity.
